prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: immersive full-bleed website background, panoramic landscape, not a contained illustration
Primary request: Create an original, poetic and quietly epic visual identity for Hetu Luoshu, an open-source novel and screenplay workspace. The central metaphor is a story becoming a bridge. It must feel like stepping into a story world, never a product placed on a studio table.
Scene/backdrop: An expansive pale jade river valley at first light. Layered blue-green distant mountains form low silhouettes on BOTH the left and right sides. In the LOWER third, an elegant long bridge arcs across a wide calm river. Its architecture is subtly made of flowing ivory manuscript paper: folded paper layers become the bridge deck and sculptural arch, believable within the landscape. One delicate continuous warm line of light follows the paper bridge like a narrative thread. Soft river mist and reflections, fine atmospheric depth. Tiny warm lights on the far bank imply another world beyond the bridge. No large buildings.
Composition/framing: Wide panoramic 16:9 landscape. Balanced left and right visual weight. All mountains, bridge and river details occupy the bottom 40 percent and outermost 15 percent of each side. The CENTRAL upper 65 percent is luminous, nearly empty pale neutral sage mist, calm and low contrast, leaving clean space for a centered dark headline, three short description lines and buttons. The horizon is low. Bridge crosses the lower center rather than dominating one side. View is elevated and expansive. Do not crop bridge endpoints. Deep yet gentle perspective, no obvious symmetry mirror.
Style/medium: Premium cinematic environmental matte painting with delicate fine-art paper texture. Elegant realism, not cute, not clay, not a toy, not a mini diorama, not generic fantasy game art. Use restrained ivory paper, Radix sage-like near-white haze, desaturated jade green, small warm amber details. Soft diffused light, no harsh contrast behind text. At the very bottom, the landscape dissolves naturally into pale paper-white mist to blend into the webpage.
Text: absolutely none, no writing on the paper
Constraints: NO moon, no sun disk, no planet, no celestial orb. No birds, no bamboo or foliage branches framing the top, because those belong to related brands. No giant book, lighthouse, old courtyard doorway, mascot, person portrait, film camera, laptop, UI, charts, floating icons, neon, cyberpunk, glowing spheres, watermark or logo. No frames, cards or borders. Avoid orange sky and sunset, heavy dark mountains and busy center.

Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: alternative immersive full-width hero background for Hetu Luoshu
Primary request: An expansive literary landscape in which a river of ivory manuscript paper quietly becomes a bridge to another story world. Mature, poetic, original, visually calm and grand. Full environment, no studio illustration.
Scene/backdrop: Dawn mist opens over a pale jade river. Low mountain ranges sit in balanced groups at the outer left and right edges. A ribbon of thin ivory paper, layered like manuscript leaves but entirely without writing, travels along the bottom left river bank and becomes a long, elegant paper bridge toward the opposite bank at lower right. Reflections and tiny amber light points lead into the distance. Air, light and water dominate; structures are subtle.
Composition/framing: Panoramic landscape, immersive 16:9. Upper two thirds and central 70 percent remain very light near-white mist for CENTERED dark text and buttons. Narrative details are kept in the lower third. Give each side equal breathing room and visual mass. No single heavy object. Entire paper bridge visible. Bottom dissolves into near-white fog for a seamless webpage continuation. No vignette.
Style/medium: Refined landscape illustration informed by Chinese ink wash and modern cinematic matte painting. Fine hand-laid paper grain, elegant real water reflections, subtle depth. Desaturated jade and sage, ivory and sparse warm light. Calm but ambitious, a high-quality literary product identity rather than a fantasy poster.
Text: none
Avoid: moon, sun disk, planets, round light sources, birds, bamboo, foreground branches, mascot, large open book, lighthouse, courtyard miniature, people, toy materials, 3D diorama, collage, interfaces, floating icons, neon, cyberpunk, saturated orange, overexposed rays, readable writing, frame, watermark, logo.
